run-abcf53324e06: 19 checks ran, 14 FAILED on their own assertions, 5 passed. Signature-only stubs were landed first (engine/brief.ts returning empty values, answerUrl deliberately reproducing the SHIPPED defect, the park hook declared but never fired) precisely so that each check would fail on its own assertion instead of all of them failing together on a missing module - the earlier module-not-found red at run-afe7d2f56851 proved only that nothing existed.

THE 14 REDS, each with its observed failure:

R5/SP1 round trip - AssertionError 'round trip': actual '' vs the brief. The seal is empty.
R5/SP1 corruption is loud - 'Missing expected rejection: a wrong key must throw'. Nothing authenticates yet.
SP1 key url-safe - match failed, actual '' against /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.
R4/R5 the page - match failed on /location\.hash/, actual ''. No page, so no fragment-key discipline.
R4 the brief renders - match failed on /i8d/, actual ''.
R6 a served page yields a link - 'a served page yields a link': false vs true.
R7 ttl bounded - TypeError reading 'ttlS' of undefined: nothing was ever put.
R1 absolute action URL - THE HEADLINE RED: actual 'answer:t-in' against /^https:\/\/ntfy\.example\/t-in$/. This is the exact string the owner's phone refused, reproduced deliberately in the stub and caught by the check. The check discriminates.
R2 a gate looks like a gate - actual 'undefined' against /i0-brief/: the card carries no title at all today.
R3 action budget - 2 !== 3: no brief action exists.
R8/Q1 degrade named - 'none' !== 'degraded': today a failed brief is indistinguishable from no brief wanted.
R12/Q1 announcement recorded - 'the success is recorded': false. Today a SUCCESSFUL announce writes nothing, which is why the defect survived a day.
R9 parking announces - 0 !== 1: the hook is declared and never fired.
R9 the board no longer announces - false: bin/se-board.ts still calls announceOffer on its 3s timer.

THE 5 GREENS, and I am naming which are worthless rather than counting them as coverage:

VACUOUS-BY-STUB, 4 of them - they pass only because the stub does nothing, and each has a FAILING TWIN that pins the real behaviour: 'R6 a page that never serves is never announced' (publishBrief returns null unconditionally; its twin 'a served page yields a link' is red); 'R8 a store that refuses never throws' (same stub, same twin); 'R11 the token reaches neither the log nor the result nor the brief' (nothing is published or logged yet, so there is nothing to leak - it starts discriminating the moment c1 and c4 land); 'R9 nothing else announces' (the hook never fires for anyone, so the negative is trivially true - its twin 'parking on an offer announces it' is red). Each of these is honest only as half of a pair, and I am recording the pairing rather than the count.

GENUINELY GREEN, 1: 'R10 the pairing is read at announce time'. It passes for a real reason - PhoneLane now takes a transport FACTORY rather than a prebuilt transport, so config is read per announce, and a pairing written after the lane was constructed is honoured with no restart. That change landed with the stubs (it had to, since the constructor signature is part of the API the checks bind to), and the six i8 construction sites plus the board were swept to the new shape at run-ca88473f3bc3. Recording it as ALREADY BUILT rather than pretending it is still red.

So: 14 discriminating reds, 4 half-pairs whose other half is red, 1 requirement already satisfied. Nothing green for a reason I cannot name.
